question: Which syllable and goddess protect the tongue in this armor?
premises: The white and invincible goddess is associated with it
Protection is sought for the tongue
inference: May the syllable ṣa and the white, invincible goddess protect me on the tongue.
uncertainties: jihvāyāñcā contains sandhi/fusion of jihvāyām and ca; analyzed as fused form
plain_english: May the syllable ṣa and the white, invincible goddess protect me on the tongue.
